records.original_title: fix(#28): prevent owner Google Drive passphrase form false 403 [skip netlify]
records.original_body:
**Source-confirmed browser/server header conflict.** The live owner setup GET sets `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, so a native navigation form POST may have `Origin: null` (documented MDN behavior). Existing POST requires exact `https://app.dialincollective.com` before checking the valid passphrase, hence recurring 403 even with matching secret. Live Netlify GET 200/POST 403 logs independently corroborate the failure, but do **not** expose the actual Origin request header; no fabricated request-header observation.

**Narrow correction:** Only the owner passphrase form's GET response now uses `Referrer-Policy: same-origin`; this allows browsers to supply the real Origin on same-origin native POST. All OAuth callbacks, token exchange and unrelated pages remain `no-referrer`. Strict Origin verification, timing-safe passphrase match and owner-only `drive.file`/folder proof unchanged. Added regression for the form response header, correct Origin -> 303 Google, rejected `Origin:null` / missing Origin / cross-origin, and OAuth redirect `no-referrer`. New explicit IN_PROGRESS queue item; previously DEPLOYED setup is kept accurately recorded. Production passphrase was subsequently edited after last deploy; new separately authorized release will also refresh Netlify function environment.

Same-commit preflight receipt in scoped #28 journal: development `b3e48350030d9a10ea3b59318b2a7f338eb17658`, `docs/ai/PREFLIGHT.md` Git blob `2fb236bbfa6bac48513eeb3bd157b260853af06d`. No backup/provider/DB writes. CI and READY pending. **Not authorization to publish**. Owner `Get this fixed` + `Find it` authorizes development, not release.
records.semantic: Confirmed historical mismatch between no-referrer form GET and strict Origin POST, followed by an intentionally narrow same-origin response-policy correction. The PR admits it did not observe actual request Origin and records CI/production as pending; do not treat a merged fix as live Drive provider acceptance or current backup success.

records.original_title: fix(#28): unblock Chrome/Safari Google Drive authorization handoff [skip netlify]
records.original_body:
Owner reproduced apparently inert **Authorize Google Drive** clicks. Live Netlify POSTs returned 303 to Google but initial HTML `Content-Security-Policy: form-action 'self'` blocks external redirects after a form submission in Chromium (cross-browser inconsistency). The accepted passphrase was not the problem.

Fix only the owner-only OAuth handoff: successful password POST returns CSP-safe no-store HTML; nonce-bound script performs top-level navigation to exact Google authorization URL; visible direct link remains if navigation is blocked. Strict Origin, password, PKCE, minimal `drive.file`, signed session cookies, no-referrer, private folder and existing backups unchanged. Regression test covers browser handoff, link, cookie, no secret leakage and original CSP.

**Preflight** live development `d3b9b39d5a932b4161a5ed712166441f197eb2a1`, blob `2fb236bbfa6bac48513eeb3bd157b260853af06d`; same-commit journal. **No publication authorized** by this fix; merge only after required checks, then prepare isolated READY queue item. Google Picker's separate third-party-cookie error requires follow-up evidence; do not misstate it resolved.
records.semantic: CSP form-action self may prevent cross-site redirect after POST despite 303, separate from wrong passphrase. Nonce navigation and direct-link fallback were narrow fixes; Google Picker cookie error and real provider acceptance remain separate and are not claimed resolved.
